chatHistory.content:
Build a 5-second hero card for the "TripAdvisor Reviews Scraper" Actor.
  Highlight the phrase "every review, every property" in the headline.
  Underneath, show three checkmark bullets:
  - 50+ reviews/min
  - ratings, dates, and reviewer profiles
  - export to CSV or JSON

  What to look for in the result:

  - Background is BRAND.colors.bg (#161718), flat — no gradients
  - Small Apify wordmark top-left
  - Headline in GT Walsheim with "every review, every property" wrapped in an orange-tinted pill (orangeTint bg + orange border)
  - Three rows with orange ✓ checkmarks
  - Maybe a couple of orange + crosshairs in the corners
